name: Prompt Eval Grid
blurb: test inputs run against prompt variants on a real model, each answer scored by rules or a judge, in one grid
intro: Runs every test case through every prompt variant on a real model (in the app), then scores each answer with rule checks - contains, regex, valid JSON, a JSON Schema subset, length, equals expected - and an optional LLM-judge rubric, and shows pass rates, cost and latency per variant.

inputs.label: Prompt variants
inputs.default:
### plain
Extract the part from this BOM line as JSON with the keys mpn, manufacturer, qty and refdes.

{{input}}

### strict
You convert one line of a bill of materials to JSON. Output only a JSON object: no prose, no code fence.
Keys: mpn (the manufacturer part number exactly as written), manufacturer (string or null), qty (integer), refdes (array of reference designators, ranges expanded: R14-R16 -> R14, R15, R16).
If the line names a part and then a replacement, use the replacement.
---
{{input}}

### few-shot
You convert one line of a bill of materials to JSON. Output only a JSON object with the keys mpn, manufacturer, qty, refdes. Expand designator ranges; qty is the number of designators.
---
Example:
C1-C3 1uF 0402 Samsung CL05A105KA5NQNC
{"mpn":"CL05A105KA5NQNC","manufacturer":"Samsung","qty":3,"refdes":["C1","C2","C3"]}

Now this line:
{{input}}
inputs.help: Each starts with ### name. A line --- splits the system prompt (above) from the user message (below). {{input}} is replaced by the case input, {{expected}} by its expected text.

inputs.label: Test cases
inputs.default:
### r-range resistor with a designator range
R12, R14-R16 | 10k 1% 0402 | Yageo RC0402FR-0710KL
expected: RC0402FR-0710KL

### c-pair two capacitors
C3,C7 100nF X7R 0603 50V Murata GRM188R71H104KA93D
expected: GRM188R71H104KA93D

### mcu single IC with a note
U4 STM32G431CBU6 (ST), UFQFPN48, program before assembly
expected: STM32G431CBU6

### usb connector
J1 USB-C receptacle 16p, GCT USB4105-GF-A, qty 1
expected: USB4105-GF-A

### led-sub part replaced in the line
D1-D3 LED green 0603 Kingbright APHHS1005ZGC -> use APTD1608LZGCK (EOL)
expected: APTD1608LZGCK
check: not_contains: APHHS1005ZGC
inputs.help: Each starts with ### id (and an optional title). The rest is the input, except lines starting expected: and check:.

inputs.label: Checks for every case
inputs.help: One per line: contains: x, not_contains: x, starts_with: x, regex: /p/i, not_regex: /p/, json, schema: {...}, max_chars: N, max_words: N, equals_expected, contains_expected, judge: N.

inputs.label: Judge rubric (empty = no judge)
inputs.default: refdes must list every designator on the line with ranges expanded (R14-R16 -> R14, R15, R16), and qty must equal the number of designators. Score 5 only if both hold; 3 if one of them is off by one; 1 if refdes still contains a range.
inputs.help: With a rubric each answer is also sent to the judge model, which replies with a 1-5 score and a reason.

inputs.label: Model
inputs.help: Empty = the server's default model. The page lists the models the server offers.

inputs.label: Answers (JSONL, filled by Run)
inputs.help: One JSON object per line: variant, case, text, and optionally ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost, model, error, judge {score, reason} or judge_text. The page writes these when it runs; an agent can pass its own.

examples.title: Support ticket triage: 2 variants x 4 cases, equals_expected, no answers yet

input.variants:
### short
Classify this support message as one of: bug, question, feature, billing. Answer with the label only.

{{input}}

### reasoned
You triage support messages for a firmware product. Labels: bug (something broke or behaves wrongly), question (how-to), feature (a request for something new), billing (invoices, plans, refunds).
Answer with exactly one label in lower case and nothing else.
---
{{input}}
input.cases:
### m1
After updating to 2.4.1 the gateway reboots every few minutes.
expected: bug

### m2
How do I change the LoRa region to AS923?
expected: question

### m3
Could you add MQTT over WebSockets?
expected: feature

### m4
I was charged twice for March.
expected: billing

usage: Give variants (### name blocks, --- between system and user, {{input}} placeholder), cases (### id blocks with optional expected: and check: lines), checks (one per line), an optional judge rubric and judgePass, and answers as JSONL {variant, case, text, ...} that you already obtained. It never calls a model: it returns the per-variant pass rates, a case x variant grid of checks passed, the failed checks with reasons, cost/latency totals from the answers' usage, CSV and JSONL exports, and warnings about the set-up (missing {{input}}, bad regex or schema, stale answers). With no answers it validates the set-up and lists the cells to run.
sources: JSON Schema 2020-12 Validation vocabulary (type, enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems/maxItems, minLength/maxLength, pattern, minimum/maximum) - a subset, implemented here
Zheng et al., 'Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena', NeurIPS 2023 (judge biases; why rule checks come first)
Redline /api/tools/llm (backend/tools_llm.py): the model call, its limits and the usage it reports
FNV-1a hash (Fowler, Noll, Vo) for spotting answers made from an older prompt
